# library-api

A REST API for a small library where members borrow books and librarians track loans with due dates.

> Generated by the Autonomous AI Software Engineering Platform (offline provider).
> Review the code before deploying it anywhere that matters.

## Run locally

```bash
python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Open http://localhost:8000/docs for the interactive OpenAPI UI.

## Test

```bash
ruff check . && pytest
```

## Container

```bash
docker build -t library-api:local .
docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 library-api:local
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Liveness probe |
| `GET` | `/members` | List members |
| `POST` | `/members` | Create a member |
| `GET` | `/members/{member_id}` | Get one member |
| `PATCH` | `/members/{member_id}` | Update a member |
| `DELETE` | `/members/{member_id}` | Delete a member |
| `GET` | `/books` | List books |
| `POST` | `/books` | Create a book |
| `GET` | `/books/{book_id}` | Get one book |
| `PATCH` | `/books/{book_id}` | Update a book |
| `DELETE` | `/books/{book_id}` | Delete a book |
| `GET` | `/librarians` | List librarians |
| `POST` | `/librarians` | Create a librarian |
| `GET` | `/librarians/{librarian_id}` | Get one librarian |
| `PATCH` | `/librarians/{librarian_id}` | Update a librarian |
| `DELETE` | `/librarians/{librarian_id}` | Delete a librarian |
| `GET` | `/loans` | List loans |
| `POST` | `/loans` | Create a loan |
| `GET` | `/loans/{loan_id}` | Get one loan |
| `PATCH` | `/loans/{loan_id}` | Update a loan |
| `DELETE` | `/loans/{loan_id}` | Delete a loan |

## Deployment

* `deploy/k8s/` - Kustomize base (Deployment, Service). Set `DATABASE_URL` through the
  referenced Secret.
* `deploy/terraform/` - AWS ECR + ECS Fargate service. Run `terraform init && terraform
  plan` with your own VPC and subnets; nothing is applied automatically.

See `ARCHITECTURE.md` for components and design decisions.

"""Database engine, session factory and declarative base."""

import os
from collections.abc import Iterator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///./app.db")

_connect_args = {"check_same_thread": False} if DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite") else {}
engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args=_connect_args, pool_pre_ping=True)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, expire_on_commit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    with SessionLocal() as session:
        yield session

"""SQLAlchemy ORM models."""

from datetime import UTC, date, datetime

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, Integer, String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.db import Base


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class Member(Base):
    __tablename__ = "members"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)


class Book(Base):
    __tablename__ = "books"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    author: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    isbn: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=True)
    published_year: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)


class Librarian(Base):
    __tablename__ = "librarians"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)


class Loan(Base):
    __tablename__ = "loans"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    due_date: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=False)

    returned: Mapped[bool | None] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=True)

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI

from app.db import Base, engine
from app.routers import books, librarians, loans, members


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="Library Api", version="0.1.0", lifespan=lifespan)
app.include_router(members.router)
app.include_router(books.router)
app.include_router(librarians.router)
app.include_router(loans.router)


@app.get("/healthz", tags=["ops"])

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PAYLOAD = {
    "title": "example title",
    "author": "example author",
    "isbn": "example isbn",
    "published_year": 3,
}


def test_create_and_get_book(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created = response.json()
    assert created["title"] == "example title"
    assert created["author"] == "example author"
    assert created["isbn"] == "example isbn"
    assert created["published_year"] == 3
    fetched = client.get(f"/books/{created['id']}")
    assert fetched.status_code == 200
    assert fetched.json()["id"] == created["id"]


def test_list_book_supports_pagination(client: TestClient) -> None:
    for _ in range(3):
        assert client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/books", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 1})
    assert page.status_code == 200
    assert len(page.json()) == 2


def test_update_book(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    response = client.patch(
        f"/books/{created['id']}", json={"title": "updated title"}
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["title"] == "updated title"


def test_delete_book(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/books", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    assert client.delete(f"/books/{created['id']}").status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/books/{created['id']}").status_code == 404


def test_unknown_book_returns_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/books/999999").status_code == 404


def test_create_book_rejects_missing_required_fields(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.post("/books", json={}).status_code == 422

WORKDIR /src

ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./

FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime

COPY --from=build /opt/venv /opt/venv
WORKDIR /home/app
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz', timeout=3)"]
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

      - name: Test

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: library-api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: library-api
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: library-api:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: library-api-database
                  key: url
                  optional: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
